analysis.conflictSolution:
Conflict: A contradiction between the Head of Advising and the Registrar. The Head of Advising wants students to create a 4-year long-term plan, but the Registrar demands the system check the Live Database and block students from selecting full classes. Checking class seat availability for a semester 2 to 3 years in the future is impossible and directly conflicts with the goal of long-term planning.

Proposed Resolution: Design the system with two distinct operating modes: Planning Mode: Applied to future semesters. The system only validates prerequisite logic, allowing students to build a long-term roadmap without checking live database seating capacity; Registration Mode: Applied exclusively to the upcoming active semester. This mode connects to the live database for real-time synchronization and automatically blocks classes that are fully booked.
